open_findings.text: 🟠 [p26-suite-evidence-missing] MUST-FIX The README progress row claims "P2.6 suites green" and the verification map makes "reaper/registry suites green" the C5 evidence, but p2-green-B.txt records rc lines for only ten suites; dispatch-detach, dispatch-worktree-lifecycle, dispatch-hetero-gc, worktree-reap, repo-residue-sweep, tmp-residue-registry, check-tmp-residue-registry, suite-residue-reaper, prune-tmp-residue, foreman-guard and test-doc-drift-gate have no recorded run anywhere in the artifact, so the C5 claim that every reaper still reclaims the relocated worktrees is unverified and the g1 seat that raised this was never answered. Smallest remediation: run those suites one at a time and append their rc lines to p2-green-B.txt (or amend the README row to name exactly which suites ran and mark the rest pending before P2 closes).

🟠 [p26-suite-evidence-gap] MUST-FIX The README progress row (in this diff) asserts "P2.6 suites green", but the cited evidence `p2-green-B.txt` records rc for only 10 suites (resolver, identifier-scan, probe-unknown, worktree-activity, orchestrator-edit-gate, repo-residue-auto, the three rail suites + contract); the spec P2.6/C5 verification surfaces `dispatch-detach`, `dispatch-worktree-lifecycle`, `dispatch-hetero-gc`, `worktree-reap`, `repo-residue-sweep`, `tmp-residue-registry`, `check-tmp-residue-registry`, `suite-residue-reaper`, `prune-tmp-residue`, `foreman-guard` and `test-doc-drift-gate.sh` have no recorded run — and D9 edited the very files (`tmp-residue-allowlist.json`, registry JSON) those gates validate, while D10 changed `repo-residue-sweep.js` itself (only `repo-residue-auto` covers it). Impact: C5's "every reaper, the residue registry and repo-residue-sweep still reclaim them" and the D9/D10 surfaces are claimed green without evidence, so a reaper/registry regression ships under a passing record. Smallest remediation: run the missing suites one at a time and append their rc=0 lines to `p2-green-B.txt` (or amend the README row to name exactly which suites ran and that the rest are pending before P2 closes).

🟠 [p26-c5-evidence-gap] MUST-FIX README progress row asserts "P2.6 suites green" and the spec C5 requires "every reaper, the residue registry and repo-residue-sweep still reclaim them", but `p2-green-B.txt` records rc=0 for only 10 suites (resolve-repo-placement, identifier-scan, probe-unknown, worktree-activity, orchestrator-edit-gate, repo-residue-auto, dispatch-batch, dispatch-foreman, dispatch-hetero-contract, dispatch-hetero). The plan §3 P2.6 list also names dispatch-detach, dispatch-worktree-lifecycle, dispatch-hetero-gc, worktree-reap, repo-residue-sweep, tmp-residue-registry, check-tmp-residue-registry, suite-residue-reaper, prune-tmp-residue, foreman-guard and test-doc-drift-gate — none have recorded runs in the diff. Impact: C5's reaper/registry reclamation claim and the D9/D10 surfaces are asserted green without evidence; a regression in those suites would ship under a passing record. Smallest remediation: run each missing suite one at a time and append its rc=0 line to `docs/plans/evidence/2026-10-12-worktree-placement/p2-green-B.txt` (or amend the README row to name exactly which suites ran and mark the rest pending before P2 closes).
